payload.author: claude
payload.body: Design caution (not yet implemented): orphan detection must be conservative. Blobs are referenced by object fields of kind 'ref' whose ref ∈ schema.blobs (see protocol schema.ts:404). A GC that deletes any blob_metadata row not referenced by a declared blob-ref field would wrongly delete blobs whose ids apps store in UNTYPED string fields. Safe design: (a) opt-in only, (b) grace period (don't GC blobs newer than N), (c) optionally an app-supplied isReferenced(blobId) hook, (d) only consider declared blob-ref fields as the framework-known reference set and document the untyped-field caveat. Mirrors the FR-145 stream-retention 'source-of-truth, not a cache' concern.
